name: Community Route - Founders Banner From The London Fundraising Panel
description: Founders now opens on a wide room shot: our own 2026 London mixer panel, Fundraising in the era of AI-native startups, with the panellists under the slide and the audience in front. It replaces a tight crop of two people that the short banner cut off at the forehead. The focus sits 58% down, so the panellists' faces stay in frame on desktop; a phone shows the whole room.
